metadata.title: Wild Chili Pickle
metadata.description:
Click to tweet and share this recipe: http://ctt.ec/N35hj

Wild chilies though tiny in size,  pack a lot of heat in them and are quite powerful.  These chilies are used primarily for pickling in the Northeastern India and this extremely hot, mouth watering and lip smacking savory pickle made with naturally available ingredients is good to go with meals as a side.

There are many different methods for pickling Chilies, I have used a method where we deep fry the chilies with lemon juice to preserve it.
